# Re-elect Mayor Adam Loraine
Building a sustainable future for San Mateo
SEE THE RECORD
It has been a privilege to serve you for the past four years, including this year as Mayor. I’m tremendously proud of what we have accomplished. We have:
• Reduced retail theft citywide by 16% after approving a budget for our police department that co-led a regional retail theft task force.
• Repaved 19 miles of streets in San Mateo through the Smooth Streets Program and renovated Central Park and East Hillsdale Park.
• Transformed San Mateo’s downtown pedestrian mall into a new city treasure by keeping it two blocks long and investing in greater amenities and pedestrian safety measures.
• Banned the use of gas-powered leaf blowers, helping to improve air quality and prevent noise pollution.
• Raised millions in new stormwater funding to make our infrastructure more resilient and prevent flooding after the storms of 2022/23.
• Invested in projects like the Beresford Solar Carport that improve our city today, and save our tax dollars tomorrow.
• Built consensus toward San Mateo’s General Plan Update, which preserves our neighborhoods while ensuring the housing we desperately need gets built.
### Proudly endorsed by the San Mateo County Democratic Party
I know San Mateo from growing up here. I attended Aragon High School and College of San Mateo. After my parents lost their house in the Great Recession, I stayed and served my community.
​
As a Sustainability and Infrastructure Commissioner, I helped shape the City's 20-year policy vision and supported millions of dollars of citywide infrastructure projects benefiting every San Matean.
​
Now as a member of San Mateo City Council, I work every day to fight for the people of San Mateo. I am committed to protecting our neighborhood vitality, public safety and services. I will continue to defend your civil rights and San Mateo's values of inclusivity and equality.
